checks.instructions: Tap WASD and arrows; hold a direction to confirm one step only. Hold Space + direction to preview. At high refresh, release Space immediately after pressing direction: no turn may commit, including a pit pull. Release Space, then make a fresh direction tap to commit. Undo a turn and a pit loss with Z. R retries; Escape pauses/resumes.
Fill all docks across six rooms. Check shielding, simultaneous pulls, jams and pit failure. Enter advances a clear; Z reverses it before advancing. No clock or move limit.

Inspect 800x450 and 1280x720 native windows. Read instructions, numbered crates, docks and striped pits. Preview counts must match moving crates, jammed crates and dock arrivals; pit previews must warn explicitly. Inspect crossed jam arrows, suction pulses and dock-arrival flashes. Confirm shared panels and save notices remain legible.
K saves and L loads a changed board including undo history. Undo after loading, then retry the same room. Escape pause must prevent gameplay.

At high refresh, tap a direction then switch applications before the next fixed tick. The shared engine native focus adapter must discard pending movement, preview, Z and Enter commands and freeze puzzle ticks. Return with a direction or Space held: release every control, then make a fresh tap. No delayed turn may occur. Repeat with a pit preview, an already-cleared room, and focus-out/focus-in between ticks. Confirm K/L and Escape still work after returning. Verify separately on Windows and Linux X11.

Listen for pull/jam cues, distinct dock-arrival success cues and pit-loss cues. Toggle M and confirm saved sound setting. Forecast summaries, jam crosses, dock flashes and suction pulses must remain readable when muted.
